name: repo-harness-tuner
description: Answer what Codex should do next for a repo, tune its harness, and recommend minimal adapter skills.

interface.shortDescription: Tell Codex what to do next, tune repo harnesses, and recommend minimal adapter skills.
interface.longDescription: Repo Harness Tuner is a Codex workspace tuner. Its friendly `next` entry point answers what Codex should do next by inspecting a repo, diagnosing the agent workflow, choosing the next safe action, suggesting validation, and surfacing approval boundaries before writes happen. The one-command doctor and run-loop keep the same engine available for health checks and full analyze, diagnose, design, factory-plan, tune, evaluate, history-track, and skill recommendation passes. The closed loop persists scored eval results in Docs/AI/harness-eval-results.jsonl and feeds eval/history signals back into diagnose, tune, factory, run-loop next-action selection, adaptive cadence, human-involvement suggestions, and skill curator recommendations. Factory output stays grounded in concrete repo evidence such as project markers, package scripts, harness files, source markers, validation commands, stale artifacts, conflicts, installed skill overlaps, and closed-loop feedback. The skill recommendation layer ranks repo-fit capabilities, can consider ECC seed catalog candidates, writes reviewable recommendation plans, and installs only small Codex adapter skills after explicit confirmation. It does not bulk-install ECC hooks, MCP servers, slash commands, native agents, marketplace entries, or policy changes. The fixture suite covers empty, Vite/Node, Unity, Codex plugin, already-harnessed, history-pressure, and eval-score-pressure project shapes so later changes have regression coverage. The factory side designs project-specific Codex agent roles, planned skills, orchestration docs, visible/background worker policies, repo-local team/skill artifacts, copyable Codex SKILL.md drafts, confirmed generated skill installs, and Codex plugin team presets. The engine side runs analyze, diagnose, design, tune, restructure, evaluate, and feedback loops for repo-local Codex harness design. It includes codex-harness-setup so one plugin can bootstrap, generate reviewable diffs, tune, review, evaluate, score and persist evaluation results, track history feedback, recommend adapter skills, and manage AGENTS.md, Docs/AI/*, validation guidance, human-involvement policy, Codex worker patterns, target files, and next review triggers as the project evolves.
